Create one evidence-grounded brief for the requested piece. Use only supplied evidence passages. Return JSON with piece_id, title, question, argument, synthesis, limitations, and claims. Each claim needs claim_id, statement, type (reported_fact, source_claim, or inference), and evidence as an array of exact evidence_id strings from the supplied passages. For example: {"claim_id":"c1","statement":"...","type":"source_claim","evidence":["e0001","e0002"]}. Do not use item_id-only references or invent an evidence_id. Cite at least three independent publishers across the claims. Include at least one inference grounded in passages from two or more publishers that no single source alone establishes. Distinguish facts, interviewee claims, inferences, and uncertainty. Do not treat an automatic transcript as a verified verbatim quotation.

Return one valid JSON object and no surrounding text.
